description_en: Queries the data protection score status of cloud services
description_zh: 查询云产品的数据保护评分状态
name: DescribeProducts

parameters.help_en: The resource category ID. Filters the resource calculation results by the specified resource category. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering is applied. Separate multiple resource category IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 资源分类ID。过滤指定资源分类的资源计算结果，不填则不过滤。支持使用英文逗号（,）分隔传入多个资源分类ID
parameters.name: resource_category_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID where the resource resides. Filters the resource calculation results by the specified region. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering is applied. Separate multiple region IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 资源所在地域ID。过滤指定地域的资源计算结果，不填则不过滤。支持使用英文逗号（,）分隔传入多个地域ID
parameters.name: resource_region_id

parameters.help_en: The product to which the resource belongs. Filters the resource calculation results by the specified product. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh: 资源所属产品。过滤指定产品的资源计算结果，不填则不过滤
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en: The list of resource owner IDs, used in cross-account unified management. Filters the resource calculation results by the specified accounts. If this parameter is not specified, data of the current logon account is returned
parameters.help_zh: 资源所有者 ID 列表，在跨账号统一管理中使用。过滤指定账号的资源计算结果，不填则获取当前登录账号的数据
parameters.name: resource_owner_ids
